paragraphs.text: Arboria , also called the Pinelands , is a forested area in the south-west portion of Jamuraa on Dominaria .

Arboria lies north of the Great Wall and west of the Blue Mountains . To the north, it reaches Amrou Haven and Buzzard's Bay . The forest is a gloomy place, dim under towering trees rearing straight to a dense interwoven canopy. Pine needles carpet the ground so thickly that even footfalls are muffled. Usually, people don't travel through the forest, since it is home to the People of the Pines, a human tribe which hunts and traps and trades with the Buzzard's Bay. Pixies and Fire Sprites are also known to inhabit the area.

Until 3334 AR, Arboria was stalked by the Akron Legionnaire s, who kidnapped the pinefolk to feed them to their master, the vampire Shauku , who resided in a castle in ruin deep in the forest. Another horror known to feed on the unwary traveler of the forest was the Floral Spuzzem , which was, in reality, one of the first inhabitants of Jamuraa cursed by the Cosmic Horror imprisoned in Shauku's castle. After the intervention of Jedit Ojanen , Adira Strongheart and her Circle of Seven, the vampire's castle was destroyed, ending the menace of the Akron Legionnaires and the Spuzzem, even if Shauku herself would later resurface further north, in Zhalfir .
During Dominaria's preparation for the New Phyrexian invasion, Arboria manifested a new Maro-Sorcerer , whose name is currently unknown.
